additional_info.body:
Hi
Andre Albino,
I have updated the charger to the requested firmware version 4.0.11. However, we are experiencing several errors, and we suspect that all the errors are related to the QA1 error, specifically the closing failure. Can you arrange for a site intervention to assess the feasibility of the component and its connections? If feasible, please consider ordering a spare part to bring along for the intervention. This way, if the QA1 is indeed faulty, we can replace it and get the charger operational again.
